narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as educational content and a promotional tool for a dermatology clinic. It uses a conversational consultation format to explain why A-acid (Tretinoin) is more effective for textured acne than traditional facials or makeup, specifically for a bride-to-be with limited time before her wedding.
